fields.v: Partly (0.5): harness formally defined (5-tuple H = (N, C, S, V, R)), DSL task types and an example pipeline (Listing 1) given, and the tiered decomposition of the case study stated; but the case study itself is described in a few sentences, with no prompts, specification, baseline procedure or measurement procedure
fields.quote: Listing 1 shows an example DSL configuration. Unlike conventional CI/CD definitions, governance control is treated as a first-class construct.
fields.where: §IV.B Example Implementation Reflecting the Execution Control Model, p. 3
fields.why: The approach itself is described with a formal model, DSL task types and an example configuration, so No (0) may understate Q2; only the case-study procedure is thin.
fields.doubt: O artigo descreve a abordagem com algum detalhe (modelo formal, tipos de tarefa da DSL, exemplo YAML na Listing 1); só o estudo de caso é curto. Vê as págs. 2-3 e decide se Q2 é Não (0) ou Parcial (0,5), coerente com o registo 800486642 (Parcial).
